keyword.title: Keyword (optional)
keyword.description: Free-text search across filings (e.g. a company name or industry term). Leave blank to return all new Form D filings.

states.title: States (optional)
states.description: Two-letter state codes to filter by business location (e.g. "CA", "NY"). Leave empty for nationwide.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back from today to include, by filing date.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of filings to return, most recently filed first.
